name: cavemio-dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown menu
description: Actions behind a button: the menu rises off the trigger, one highlight glides between rows, and checkbox rows draw their tick in place.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Placement, presence and dismissal live in floating.ts, shared by tooltip, popover, dropdown and context menus: they all flip, shift, enter and leave the same way.
- role="menu" with menuitem and menuitemcheckbox rows.
- Reduced motion: the menu fades; the highlight jumps.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: items
props.description: – · Rows ({ id, label, icon, shortcut, destructive, disabled, onSelect }), { type: "checkbox", checked, onCheckedChange }, { type: "label" } and { type: "separator" }.

useCases.title: Row actions
useCases.description: Edit, duplicate, delete on a "…" button.

useCases.title: Account menus
useCases.description: Profile, settings, sign out under an avatar.

features.title: Gliding highlight
features.description: One fill moves between rows (220ms) for pointer and keys alike.

features.title: Keyboard
features.description: Enter/Space/↓ open on the first row, ↑ on the last; arrows wrap; typing jumps.

features.title: Checkable rows
features.description: A drawn tick, aria-checked, menu stays open.

features.title: Plain data
features.description: items: rows, labels and separators as objects.

states.title: open
states.description: Rises off the trigger (320ms); flips above if needed.

states.title: move
states.description: The highlight glides to the row under the pointer or the key.

states.title: pick
states.description: Closes (180ms) and focus returns to the trigger; checkbox rows stay open and draw their tick (280ms).
